from pathlib import Path
import json,re
b=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'

def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v,(dict,list)): v=json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
    s=str(v if v is not None else '')
    return s.replace('\n',' ').replace('\r',' ').replace('|','/').replace('{','(').replace('}',')')[:3500]

print('ERROR='+'|'.join(vals))
raise SystemExit(1)
